name: cgb_classic_platinum
description: A platinum-card monthly statement print layout (validated on 192 consecutive monthly PDFs spanning more than a decade, nearly 6,000 transactions). Use as a worked example; column coordinates are PDF-point specific and will differ for other banks.
notes: A '积分' (points) row carries a monetary-looking amount but is NOT money; it must be dropped or the running balance is off by tens of thousands.
USD rows are listed alongside CNY in the reconciliation table; only the base-currency row may enter the ledger.
'无欠款' is NOT zero — it usually accompanies an overpayment, so the effective balance is negative.
'分期冲帐' reverses the original purchase when an instalment is created; it is not an early settlement.
